description: This file defines the InvalidParamException class used for handling invalid parameter errors within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the base PHP Exception class and includes additional properties and methods for managing an error bag containing invalid parameters.

classes.name: InvalidParamException
classes.description: Custom exception class for invalid parameters, supports storing and retrieving a bag of errors related to invalid parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the error bag and calling the parent constructor with message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: getErrorBag
methods.description: Returns the array of errors associated with invalid parameters.

methods.name: setErrorBag
methods.description: Sets the error bag with a new array of errors.

methods.name: getNormalizedErrorBag
methods.description: Returns a normalized array containing the keys of the invalid parameters.
